title: El Salvador's president says missile strike destroyed 400 Mawozo gang headquarters
detail: El Salvador's president Nayib Bukele said helicopter/missile strikes, carried out with a Haitian police task force backed by Salvadoran troops, destroyed the headquarters of the 400 Mawozo gang and the home of leader Lanmò San Jou. The operation followed the Oct 18 abduction of four Salvadoran mission members. Haiti's prime minister praised the joint strike; local media reported up to 20 deaths (unverified). The BBC could not verify Bukele's video or that the site was the gang's headquarters; Amnesty urged compliance with international human rights law.

media.caption: El Salvador fires missiles on Haitian gang hideout

confidenceReason: Multiple Tier-2 outlets report the strike; site identity and casualties not independently verified.
